title: What GOTCHA is allowed to do
description: Three settings for everything: do it, ask me first, never. This applies to every AI employee.

disconnect.confirm: GOTCHA will stop using {name}: its actions stop working and the sign-in details saved for it are deleted. Its action settings are not deleted.
disconnect.confirmShopify: GOTCHA will ask Shopify to uninstall the GOTCHA app from your store. Once Shopify confirms, the chat in your store and every Shopify action stop, and Shopify ends the Shopify Connector subscription and its billing. Connecting again later starts afresh.

wooFirewall.title: Your store's firewall stopped GOTCHA
wooFirewall.lead: The keys weren't checked: the store's firewall{name, select, none {} other { ({name})}} blocked GOTCHA's server before the request reached WooCommerce. New keys won't help.
wooFirewall.ipScope: Only GOTCHA's address skips the firewall. Everyone else is checked as before.
wooFirewall.pathScope: Requests to {path} skip the firewall. WooCommerce still asks them for the store's keys, and your pages and checkout stay protected.
wooFirewall.mayChange: GOTCHA's address may still change. If it does, this rule stops working.
wooFirewall.thenConnect: When the rule is deployed, connect the store again.

step.create: Go to <ui>Security › Security rules</ui>, press <ui>Create rule</ui> and choose <ui>Custom rules</ui>. (Older dashboards: <ui>Security › WAF › Custom rules</ui>, then <ui>Create rule</ui>.)
step.skipAll: Action <ui>Skip</ui>, and tick every option under it.
step.skipPath: Action <ui>Skip</ui>: tick <ui>All remaining custom rules</ui>, and under <ui>More components to skip</ui> tick <ui>Super Bot Fight Mode</ui>.
step.botFight: If <ui>Bot Fight Mode</ui> is on (<ui>Security › Bots</ui>), turn it off: a rule can't skip it.

wooFirewall.host: Ask your host to allow requests to {path}. If the store uses a security plugin{name, select, none {} other { ({name})}}, allow that path in its settings.
wooFirewall.copy: Copy the steps for your developer
